hero.title: July 2024: A Ledger of Truth
hero.subtitle: A decentralized, forensically verified justice and rehabilitation platform for the martyrs, injured, and persecuted.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: The July 2024 mass uprising claimed lives, left thousands injured, and left many facing fabricated charges. July Ledger preserves their stories, brings transparency to relief and budget allocation, and makes every record tamper-proof through forensic verification and blockchain anchoring.
